chunk_findings.detail: The guard only recognizes `monkeypatch.setattr` calls whose target is a bare `ast.Name` previously bound to `ddflow.infra.log` via an aliased import. It misses a test file containing `import ddflow.infra.log` (no alias) and then `monkeypatch.setattr(ddflow.infra.log, "APPEND_HOOKS", [...])`: `_log_package_bindings` ignores that import because `alias.asname` is `None`, and `_patched_on_package` skips that target because it is an `ast.Attribute`, not an `ast.Name`. This is exactly the package-level by-value re-export patch the new guard is supposed to refuse, but the guard passes.

chunk_findings.detail: The guard only flags `monkeypatch.setattr` when the target is a bare `ast.Name` previously bound as an alias of `ddflow.infra.log`. A test that does `import ddflow.infra.log` and `monkeypatch.setattr(ddflow.infra.log, "APPEND_HOOKS", [boom])` (target is an `ast.Attribute`) or `monkeypatch.setattr("ddflow.infra.log.APPEND_HOOKS", [boom])` (pytest string form; `args[1]` is not the name constant) rebinds only the package copy, so the submodule still reads the original. `_patched_on_package` returns `[]`, `test_no_test_patches_an_infra_log_reexport_on_the_package` passes, and the vacuous patch the test exists to refuse is missed.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_no_reexport_patches.py:_patched_on_package

chunk_findings.detail: The earlier miss on `monkeypatch.setattr(ddflow.infra.log, "APPEND_HOOKS", ...)` is fixed, but the string form called out in the same finding is unchanged. `monkeypatch.setattr("ddflow.infra.log.APPEND_HOOKS", [boom])` is the documented one-argument dotted path: pytest treats `args[0]` as the target string and `args[1]` as the value, so the `isinstance(name, ast.Constant) and isinstance(name.value, str)` check returns early and the call is never recorded. That call still rebinds only the package re-export; the sibling submodule keeps its list, `boom` never runs, and `test_no_test_patches_an_infra_log_reexport_on_the_package` stays green. The same hole is `monkeypatch.setattr(target=logmod, name="APPEND_HOOKS", value=[boom])`: `len(node.args) < 2` skips keyword setattr, so a by-value re-export patch on the package is still invisible to the guard.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_no_reexport_patches.py:_patched_on_package

chunk_findings.detail: The guard still misses valid pytest `monkeypatch.setattr` string-target forms when `value` is supplied in a way that keeps `value is not None` true. For a test file containing `monkeypatch.setattr(target="ddflow.infra.log.APPEND_HOOKS", value=[...])`, control enters the first branch with `name` absent, so line 102 `isinstance(name, ast.Constant)` is false and the call is skipped before being recorded. Likewise `monkeypatch.setattr("ddflow.infra.log", "APPEND_HOOKS", [...])` is skipped because `_is_log_package` returns False for a string `Constant` target. Both calls rebind only the package re-export, so the original vacuous-patch bug still passes this regression test undetected, despite the function docstring asserting all three forms are refused alike.

chunk_findings.detail: The two-argument dotted form is handled, but the ordinary three-argument form with a string module is not. `monkeypatch.setattr("ddflow.infra.log", "APPEND_HOOKS", [boom])` (and the same call with `target=`/`name=`/`value=` keywords) is valid pytest: the string is imported and the name is rebound on the package only, so the submodule binding is untouched and the test can still pass vacuously. In that call `value` is present, so the first branch runs; `target` is an `ast.Constant`, `_is_log_package` returns false, and the call is never recorded.

chunk_findings.detail: The previous finding still holds for keyword string-target shorthand. A test file containing `monkeypatch.setattr(target="ddflow.infra.log.APPEND_HOOKS", value=[boom])` is valid pytest: `name` is absent but `value` is an AST node, so `value is not None` is true and control enters the first branch. The code then requires `name` to be an `ast.Constant`, sees `name` is `None`, and `continue`s without recording the offender.
